say:12:1521002011:0.female: Even with all the hatred between us and the Halians

choice:2:1:2.male: And Perseus should still be in the city.
choice:2:1:2.female: And Perseus should still be in the city.

choice:2:2:3.female: We'll have to blend in. That means disguises.

say:1:1521008001:0.text: Who are you? What do you want?!
say:1:1521008001:0.source_cn: 你你你……你们是谁？想干什么？！
say:1:1521008001:0.male: Who are you? What do you want?!
say:1:1521008001:0.female: Who are you? What do you want?!

say:2:1521008002:0.text: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!
say:2:1521008002:0.source_cn: 我告诉你们……我才不怕你们呢！
say:2:1521008002:0.male: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!
say:2:1521008002:0.female: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!

choice_prompt:3:1521008002.text: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!
choice_prompt:3:1521008002.source_cn: 我告诉你们……我才不怕你们呢！
choice_prompt:3:1521008002.male: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!
choice_prompt:3:1521008002.female: I'm telling you... I'm not afraid of you!

say:4:1521008003:0.text: You were the one speaking ill of me earlier. Don't those who insult the Regulus deserve to be punished?
say:4:1521008003:0.source_cn: ……是你们先在背后说我坏话的。说领主坏话的人不是都该受...
say:4:1521008003:0.male: You were the one speaking ill of me earlier. Don't those who insult the Regulus deserve to be punished?
say:4:1521008003:0.female: You were the one speaking ill of me earlier. Don't those who insult the Regulus deserve to be punished?

say:6:1521008005:0.text: Being the Regulus means holding great power.
say:6:1521008005:0.source_cn: 你是领主，但领主没有更了不起。

say:7:1521008006:0.text: But abusing that power—that's the worst of all.

say:8:1521008007:1.text: I haven't! I've always treated people fairly. I even sent my own guards to help civilians.
say:8:1521008007:1.source_cn: 我没有仗势欺人！我一直都对大家很好，我还派自己的护卫去...

say:9:1521008008:0.text: You spoke ill of me. I couldn't let that slide.
say:9:1521008008:0.source_cn: 要不是你们说我坏话……我也不会派人抓你们。
say:9:1521008008:0.male: You spoke ill of me. I couldn't let that slide.
say:9:1521008008:0.female: You spoke ill of me. I couldn't let that slide.

say:10:1521008009:0.text: Mr. Bakis taught me that the Regulus' authority shall never be challenged.
say:10:1521008009:0.source_cn: 比博老师说，我应该时时刻刻捍卫领主的威严！

choice_prompt:11:1521008009.text: Mr. Bakis taught me that the Regulus' authority shall never be challenged.
choice_prompt:11:1521008009.source_cn: 比博老师说，我应该时时刻刻捍卫领主的威严！

say:13:1521008011:0.text: You beat my guard. That means you're stronger than he is.
say:13:1521008011:0.source_cn: 你们把我的护卫打败了，说明你们比他更厉害。
say:13:1521008011:0.male: You beat my guard. That means you're stronger than he is.
say:13:1521008011:0.female: You beat my guard. That means you're stronger than he is.

say:14:1521008012:0.text: So... why don't you be my new guards?
say:14:1521008012:0.male: So... why don't you be my new guards?
say:14:1521008012:0.female: So... why don't you be my new guards?

choice_prompt:15:1521008012.text: So... why don't you be my new guards?
choice_prompt:15:1521008012.male: So... why don't you be my new guards?
choice_prompt:15:1521008012.female: So... why don't you be my new guards?

say:16:1521008013:0.text: I mean... I'm not looking to get hurt. I don't want to let my father down.
say:16:1521008013:0.source_cn: 可是我也不能真的出事，否则……父亲一定会失望的。

say:17:1521008014:0.text: Well, I do have somewhere to be, and I need you to watch my back!
say:17:1521008014:0.source_cn: 我现在刚好有地方要去，需要有人从旁保护。
say:17:1521008014:0.male: Well, I do have somewhere to be, and I need you to watch my back!
say:17:1521008014:0.female: Well, I do have somewhere to be, and I need you to watch my back!

say:18:1521008015:0.text: I won't be your guard, and neither will my Master.
say:18:1521008015:0.source_cn: ……我不可能当你的护卫。大人<male>他</male...
say:18:1521008015:0.male: I won't be your guard, and neither will my Master.
say:18:1521008015:0.female: I won't be your guard, and neither will my Master.

say:19:1521008016:0.text: You're supposed to answer "Yes", "Will do", or "As you wish, Regulus"!
say:19:1521008016:0.source_cn: 这不对——你们应该说“好的”、“没问题”、“听你的，领...
say:19:1521008016:0.male: You're supposed to answer "Yes", "Will do", or "As you wish, Regulus"!
say:19:1521008016:0.female: You're supposed to answer "Yes", "Will do", or "As you wish, Regulus"!

say:21:1521008018:0.text: No, you're the ones who don't make sense!

say:22:1521008019:0.text: Fine. If you won't come, I'll go alone.
say:22:1521008019:0.source_cn: 唔……算了，你们不想去我不勉强。我自己去。
say:22:1521008019:0.male: Fine. If you won't come, I'll go alone.
say:22:1521008019:0.female: Fine. If you won't come, I'll go alone.

say:23:1521008020:0.text: But don't just stand there. Go help someone else! That's an order!
say:23:1521008020:0.source_cn: 但是你们也不能什么都不做，赶快去救其他人！这是领主的命令！
say:23:1521008020:0.male: But don't just stand there. Go help someone else! That's an order!
say:23:1521008020:0.female: But don't just stand there. Go help someone else! That's an order!

say:26:1521008022:0.text: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.
say:26:1521008022:0.source_cn: 但他对您一点也不尊敬，我不喜欢他。
say:26:1521008022:0.male: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.
say:26:1521008022:0.female: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.

choice_prompt:27:1521008022.text: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.
choice_prompt:27:1521008022.source_cn: 但他对您一点也不尊敬，我不喜欢他。
choice_prompt:27:1521008022.male: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.
choice_prompt:27:1521008022.female: But he has no respect for you, I don't like him.

say:28:1521008023:0.text: I understand… for now, we just need to keep him safe.
say:28:1521008023:0.source_cn: 我明白了……只要保护他一段时间就可以了。
say:28:1521008023:0.male: I understand… for now, we just need to keep him safe.
say:28:1521008023:0.female: I understand… for now, we just need to keep him safe.

choice:27:0:1.text: He's still the ruler of Halia.
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 他毕竟是呼临城的领主
choice:27:0:1.male: He's still the ruler of Halia.
choice:27:0:1.female: He's still the ruler of Halia.

choice:27:1:2.text: If anything happens to him, it could throw the city into chaos.
choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 如果他出现意外，会引发动荡
choice:27:1:2.male: If anything happens to him, it could throw the city into chaos.
choice:27:1:2.female: If anything happens to him, it could throw the city into chaos.

choice:25:1:2.text: Sigh... We can't just leave him like this.
choice:25:1:2.male: Sigh... We can't just leave him like this.
choice:25:1:2.female: Sigh... We can't just leave him like this.

choice:15:0:1.text: I thought you said you didn't need protection?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你刚才还说不需要保护呢
choice:15:0:1.male: I thought you said you didn't need protection?
choice:15:0:1.female: I thought you said you didn't need protection?

choice:11:0:1.text: Leave it. This isn't our concern.
choice:11:0:1.male: Leave it. This isn't our concern.
choice:11:0:1.female: Leave it. This isn't our concern.

say:30:1521008004:0.text: What... That's for me to decide!

choice:3:1:2.text: Didn't you say you wanted to punish him?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 你刚才不是说要罚士兵吗
choice:3:1:2.male: Didn't you say you wanted to punish him?
choice:3:1:2.female: Didn't you say you wanted to punish him?

say:0:1521014001:0.text: *Cough*... Surah, come help me pull Vabin up!
say:0:1521014001:0.source_cn: 咳咳……苏拉，快……快帮我一把，把维比也救上来！

say:1:1521014002:0.source_cn: 有人需要帮忙！跟我过去！

say:1:1521016001:0.text: Thank you... for not leaving me behind. I really thought I was going to drown...*Cough*
say:1:1521016001:0.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢你们没有抛下我……我还以为自己会被淹死……...

say:2:1521016002:0.text: Save your breath. Spit out that water first... Achoo!
say:2:1521016002:0.source_cn: 别说这些了，先把嗓子里的水吐出来……阿嚏！

say:4:1521016004:0.text: If my clothes weren't soaked, I'd wrap you in them...
say:4:1521016004:0.source_cn: 我的衣服全湿了，不然还能脱下来给你取暖……

say:5:1521016005:0.text: It's okay. We're lucky to even have somewhere dry to sit.
say:5:1521016005:0.source_cn: 别抱怨了，现在能有个落脚的地方就不错了……

say:8:1521016006:0.text: Halia is full of people like them...
say:8:1521016006:0.source_cn: 城里到处都是这样受灾的人……

say:9:1521016007:0.text: Floods, rain... When will it end?
say:9:1521016007:0.source_cn: 暴雨和洪水，什么时候才能结束？

choice_prompt:10:1521016007.text: Floods, rain... When will it end?
choice_prompt:10:1521016007.source_cn: 暴雨和洪水，什么时候才能结束？

say:12:1521016011:0.text: Hand me some of the clothes we brought. These should <style="highlight">help them stay warm</style>.
say:12:1521016011:0.male: Hand me some of the clothes we brought. These should <style="highlight">help them stay warm</style>.
say:12:1521016011:0.female: Hand me some of the clothes we brought. These should <style="highlight">help them stay warm</style>.

say:15:1521016012:0.text: So that's what this is about... He just wants to help.
say:15:1521016012:0.source_cn: 原来他是想救助受灾的人……
say:15:1521016012:0.male: So that's what this is about... He just wants to help.
say:15:1521016012:0.female: So that's what this is about... He just wants to help.

choice:10:0:1.text: Let's focus on those we can still help.
choice:10:0:1.male: Let's focus on those we can still help.
choice:10:0:1.female: Let's focus on those we can still help.

say:18:1521016010:0.text: Let's just take care of the ones still with us.

say:0:1521017001:0.text: Thank you... Thank you for your generosity!

say:0:1521019001:0.text: All this… it must have cost you. Thank you.
say:0:1521019001:0.source_cn: 这些东西肯定不便宜，谢谢。

say:3:1521020001:1.text: I never thought I'd meet people this kind in times like these...!
say:3:1521020001:1.source_cn: 真……真没想到，这么艰难的时候还能遇到好心人……！

say:4:1521020002:0.text: Yeah... ever since the drought and famine, we've had to trade everything just to eat. I haven't worn warm clothes like this in ages...
say:4:1521020002:0.source_cn: 是啊……自从饥荒和干旱开始，我家的东西就全都拿去换食物...

say:5:1521020003:0.text: These aren't anything fancy. Just grabbed what I could from the warehouse.
say:5:1521020003:0.source_cn: 这衣服不是很普通吗？我只是从库房里随便拿了几件。

say:6:1521020004:0.text: If more people need them, I'll find a way to bring one for every...
say:6:1521020004:0.source_cn: 如果有很多人都需要的话，我应该可以给每个人都——

say:10:1521020006:0.source_cn: 你干嘛咳嗽？也感冒了吗？

say:12:1521020008:0.source_cn: 好孩子们，谢谢你们的好意。

say:13:1521020009:0.text: Actually... Vailo and I, we've been thinking about leaving Halia.
say:13:1521020009:0.source_cn: 其实……我和我丈夫瓦罗已经在考虑要不要离开呼临城了。

say:17:1521020011:1.source_cn: 这还用问吗？原因都摆在眼前了。

say:18:1521020012:1.text: First the drought, then famine, now floods and war. Our home's long gone. We've got nowhere left to stay.
say:18:1521020012:1.source_cn: 先是干旱、饥荒，又是战争、洪水……我们的房子早就变卖了...

say:19:1521020013:0.text: Good thing we traded the house for food before the flood took it.
say:19:1521020013:0.source_cn: 这还算是幸运的。至少在房子被冲塌之前，我们换来了一点口粮。

say:20:1521020014:0.text: And our son... he was sent off to war a while back. We haven't heard from him since.
say:20:1521020014:0.source_cn: 还有我们的亲人……我们的孩子很早就被征召入伍。从那以后...

say:21:1521020015:0.source_cn: 也许他早已经不在人世了……

say:22:1521020016:0.text: All that's left here is grief. We should have left a long time ago.
say:22:1521020016:0.source_cn: 呼临城是个伤心地，我们早就该离开了。

say:23:1521020017:0.text: But... where would you even go?
say:23:1521020017:0.source_cn: 可是……可是离开呼临城以后，你们要去哪？

say:26:1521020018:0.text: The nearest place is <style="highlight">Tuttleton</style>. Is that where you're heading?
say:26:1521020018:0.source_cn: 离这里最近的是<style=highlight>图塔镇...

say:28:1521020020:0.text: My teacher said even Tuttleton has suffered. No one's come to trade in a while.

say:36:1521043034:0.source_cn: 去看看雅库伯尔人到底是什么样子。

say:37:1521043035:0.text: To find out if the Wildborn are really the monsters you think they are.
say:37:1521043035:0.source_cn: 去亲眼看看，雅库伯尔人是不是和你们想的一样，是野兽。

say:38:1521043036:0.text: I have never thought about that.

say:39:1521043037:0.text: I'm not their leader, and we're too different. I can't just blend in like I do here.
say:39:1521043037:0.source_cn: 我不是他们的首领。而且……我们太不一样了。我没办法普普...

say:44:1521043040:0.text: Regulus Abundius! At last, we've found you!
say:44:1521043040:0.source_cn: ——阿邦德殿下！属下总算找到您了！

say:45:1521043041:0.source_cn: 你、你怎么找到这里来了？

say:46:1521043042:0.text: The council has called an urgent session. They await your return.
say:46:1521043042:0.source_cn: 议事官们心急如焚，都在等您回去。

say:47:1521043043:0.text: Alright, alright... I was going back anyway.
say:47:1521043043:0.source_cn: 知道了……我又没说不回去……

say:52:1521043046:0.text: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?
say:52:1521043046:0.source_cn: 你们一直在问兽人和战争的事，是不是不喜欢战争，更想要和平？
say:52:1521043046:0.male: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?
say:52:1521043046:0.female: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?

choice_prompt:53:1521043046.text: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?
choice_prompt:53:1521043046.source_cn: 你们一直在问兽人和战争的事，是不是不喜欢战争，更想要和平？
choice_prompt:53:1521043046.male: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?
choice_prompt:53:1521043046.female: You've been asking about the Wildborn and this war. Is it because you want peace?

say:55:1521043049:0.text: You're Halians, and your voices matter. Maybe one day I will go to the Wildborn lands.
say:55:1521043049:0.source_cn: 你们是呼临人，你们的意见很重要！或许将来有一天，我会像...
say:55:1521043049:0.male: You're Halians, and your voices matter. Maybe one day I will go to the Wildborn lands.
say:55:1521043049:0.female: You're Halians, and your voices matter. Maybe one day I will go to the Wildborn lands.

say:56:1521043050:0.text: When I'm the one in charge, I'll work to find a way for us all to live together.
say:56:1521043050:0.source_cn: 等到我可以做决定的那天，我一定会努力选择对大家更好的方式！

say:57:1521043051:0.text: Farewell! You're the finest guards I have ever had!
say:57:1521043051:0.source_cn: 再见啦！你们是最棒的护卫！
say:57:1521043051:0.male: Farewell! You're the finest guards I have ever had!
say:57:1521043051:0.female: Farewell! You're the finest guards I have ever had!

cinematic_dialogue:60:1521044001:.text: Regulus Abundius, you shouldn't be dressed like that.

cinematic_dialogue:60:1521044002:.text: Don't you dare tell the councilmen!
cinematic_dialogue:60:1521044002:.source_cn: 不许把这件事告诉议事官！

narration:62:15022846:0.text: Escorted by his guards, Abundius leaves the outpost and returns to Halia.
narration:62:15022846:0.source_cn: 阿邦德在侍卫的护送下离开哨卡，返回了呼临城。

choice:53:0:1.source_cn: 对，和平是最宝贵的东西

choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 你从你父亲身上学到了很多

choice:31:1:2.text: That's surprisingly wise for your age.
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 你的想法居然这么成熟
choice:31:1:2.male: That's surprisingly wise for your age.
choice:31:1:2.female: That's surprisingly wise for your age.

choice:27:0:1.text: You saw it with your own eyes? How?
choice:27:0:1.male: You saw it with your own eyes? How?
choice:27:0:1.female: You saw it with your own eyes? How?

say:64:1521043027:0.text: They did. I disguised myself and saw it myself.
say:64:1521043027:0.source_cn: 当然不是他们告诉我的。是我换了衣服，偷偷溜出去看到的。

choice:27:1:2.text: I thought the council would keep this from you.
choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为议事官会瞒着你这些事
choice:27:1:2.male: I thought the council would keep this from you.
choice:27:1:2.female: I thought the council would keep this from you.

choice:2:1:2.text: Glad to see the resolve back in your eyes.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 看来你终于找回自信了
choice:2:1:2.male: Glad to see the resolve back in your eyes.
choice:2:1:2.female: Glad to see the resolve back in your eyes.
